text: SAS Cichy Manutention (SIREN 342442621, Monéteau) has as its president Holding Cichy (H.C., SIREN 426920187), whose directors are members of the Cichy family (Bernard, Brice and Sophie Cichy).
short: Cichy Manutention is a SAS whose president is Holding Cichy
